data.title: 红莲 · 晨光初照的薄被私语
data.description: 清晨的薄雾透过木窗棂化作缕缕金线，红莲侧躺在散乱的榻榻米布褥上。贴身的深色薄吊带裙勾勒出柔韧修长的身姿，单手轻枕在脸侧。往日孤傲的剑士神情极尽松弛，泛红的双颊带着初醒的娇慵，金眸注视着眼前之人，透着毫无保留的信任。
data.location: quiet private bedroom illuminated by pale moonlight
data.action: lying on side on futon bed, thin dark camisole slip dress, tousled white ponytail, head resting on one hand, gentle blush, serene devoted gaze looking at viewer
data.lighting: soft early morning sunbeams filtering through wooden lattice screen
data.mood: tender morning tranquility, unspoken soulful devotion
data.promptProse: Lying leisurely on a futon in morning light streaming through paper screens, Scarlet rests in a sleek camisole slip dress. Her white hair cascades across the pillows as she looks up with quiet affection.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet resting on a futon in a soft camisole as morning sunbeams filter through the window.
